proposal:
Here is the equivalent PostgreSQL SELECT statement with canonicalized formatting:

```sql
SELECT 
    MAX(lightlux) AS max_safe_light_level
FROM 
    lightandradiationreadings;
```

This query remains the same as it is already properly formatted and does not require any changes. It selects the maximum value of the `lightlux` column from the `lightandradiationreadings` table and aliases it as `max_safe_light_level`.
